授業概要
歯科が対象とする疾患について解説するとともに歯科疾患の予防と口腔から健康増進を図ることを体感し、将来口腔科学を学ぶことに対する自覚と自身の健康に対する意識改革を促す。
The course will explain the diseases covered by dentistry, and encourage students to experience the prevention of dental diseases and the promotion of health through the oral cavity, and to raise their awareness of their own health and their awareness of the future study of oral science.
